source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Architect and the Old Theatre
tts_text: Old Mr. Hale was an architect, and he loved the architecture of the little town by the river. For forty years he had watched workers construct bridges, erect towers, and pour the base of every new building. He always said that a town is only as strong as its infrastructure, and that basic things matter most. That spring the town asked him to elaborate on a plan for the old theatre. On the stage of that theatre, every drama and every comedy of the town had been played. "The plan is simple," he said. "This is not a tragedy, and it is not a ridiculous or absurd idea." He opened the index of his notebook and read out the ingredients of his plan. Every element was listed there, and not one factor was forgotten. His lunch was a paste of beans and a compound of nuts, kept in a small portable box. Beside the theatre there was a pond, and behind the pond stood a complex of three old houses. The drawings seemed to perplex the young mayor. "You make a simple thing complex," the mayor said. "Complicate it more and the roof will collapse." Those words did provoke the old man. "I advocate repair, not replacement," he said, and he struck the table with his whip. "Sorry, I do not mean to confuse you," he added. "But I will not be blunt about bad work." The mayor laughed and signed.

sentences_cn: 老黑尔先生是位建筑师，他深爱着河边那座小镇的建筑。
四十年来，他看着工人们造桥、竖塔，为每一栋新楼打地基。
他总说，一座小镇的强弱全看它的基础设施，而基本的东西最重要。
那年春天，镇里请他为老剧院详细制订一份方案。
在那座剧院的舞台上，镇上的每一出戏剧和每一场喜剧都上演过。
“这不是悲剧，也不是什么可笑或荒谬的想法。”
他翻开笔记本的索引，把方案的各项要素念了出来。
每一个要素都列在上面，没有一个因素被漏掉。
他的午餐是豆泥和坚果混合物，装在一个轻便的小盒子里。
剧院旁边有个池塘，池塘后面立着三栋老房子组成的建筑群。
那些图纸似乎让年轻的镇长困惑不解。
“你把简单的事弄复杂了，”镇长说。
“再复杂化下去，屋顶就要塌了。”
“我拥护修缮，而不是拆掉重建，”他说着，用鞭子敲了敲桌子。
“抱歉，我不是想让你迷惑，”他又说。
“但面对拙劣的工程，我不会说话含糊。”
